Kwame, I replied in the thread on your message in #coastal-team. The only discount figure in the channel is 10%.

Bettina posted 12% on 2025-11-17 and corrected it to 10% five minutes later. She said she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. So 12 was a retracted figure, not the rate.

That 10% comes from a November 2025 channel message, not from a contract. I couldn't find a Saltmarsh contract or order form in the files I can read, so I can't confirm the current rate. For the brief, check with June on the deal desk.
